messages:
Anna (CSM): Quick sync — EchoBank preview cohort final invites. We have 12 seats left; asked legal for NDA yesterday. Need confirmation from Eng on telemetry hooks and from Product on demo script. Targeting next-week kickoff.
Miguel (Solutions): Can we move kickoff to Tue 9am PT? Customer execs prefer mornings. Also need marketing assets for feature names.
Priya (Onboarding): Headcount check: 24 total signed, 20 accepted invites so far, 4 pending. I'll re-send invites today at 10am PT.
Ben (Eng): Working on the sample app regression: latest agent release dropped session pinning. Temporary workaround: set header `x-rw-session: keep` in requests. Patch ETA EOD tomorrow.
Anna (CSM): @Ben thanks — can you confirm telemetry event names? We want 'preview.join' and 'preview.feedback.submitted'
Ben (Eng): Confirmed. I'll add them to the instrumentation doc: https://redwood.app/s/echo-preview-instr (internal)
Sam (Product): For feedback capture, suggest short 3-question survey + optional freeform. NPS + two task-based questions. Add a webhook to send responses to a GSheet + Slack channel.
Miguel (Solutions): Can we include an in-product trigger after the 2nd session? Less noisy.
Priya (Onboarding): I'll add the survey cadence to the invite: after 3 days and on exit. Draft text in the doc now.
OnboardBot: Reminder: kickoff meeting scheduled Tue 2024-04-09 09:00 PT — use link https://meet.redwood.com/echo-kickoff
Anna (CSM): Action items: Priya — resend invites + confirm NDA status; Ben — push quick instrument PR by EOD; Sam — draft survey payload and webhook details; Miguel — update customer-facing feature summary. I'll follow up with EchoBank contact (Janelle) today. :thumbsup:
Sam (Product): Draft survey payload:
```
{
  "questions": ["How likely to recommend?","Did the preview help your team?","Any blockers?"]
}
```
Sam (Product): I'll also prepare a 5-min demo script focused on latency/cost numbers.
Anna (CSM): Thanks team. If no blockers, I'll lock the kickoff and share calendar invites by 3pm PT. :rocket:
